agreements.requirement: Organizational capability persists separately from current delivery; funding interruptions and capability erosion have different time scales.
Maintenance competes for real money/time and is chosen through the shared decision framework.
Unfinished maintenance persists; maintenance, repair and rebuilding have different completion and recovery processes.
Policy-value and implementation-performance beliefs are distinct, learned subjectively.
Office carries decision rights; personal relationships and credibility remain with the person after office changes.
Supporter dependence influences consequences, norms and perceived control within TPB–utility.
Ordinary members, organizational leaders and national authorities are authority tiers where applicable, within four existing classes.
Insiders can span organizational categories and change with relationships; no automatic immunity.
Appointment and removal require the relevant authority, procedures and resources; appointees remain autonomous decision makers.
Agents can build, sustain, alter or oppose coalitions through costly attempts and independently evaluated commitments.
Attention and active engagement can weaken without equivalent loss of policy support.
Actors can attempt safeguard changes in every organizational category, through an available channel.
A compact organization-specific governance profile defines initiators, approvers and protections.
Political responses can be combined across demands or reform components; public claims differ from completed work.
Assess realized accountability coverage only, by relevant rank/group and eligibility.
Personal influence evolves by audience through accessed and interpreted information, not hidden analyst truth.
Month is a reporting/coupling period containing repeated, ordered interactions and appropriate process-specific updates.
Demand generates attempted encounters; staff/resource constraints limit completion, with explicit retry/delay/abandonment rules.
Shared stocks have balances; aggregates of agent beliefs are derived summaries, not duplicate autonomous stocks.
Delays follow completed work, interruptions and procedural minima rather than a guaranteed elapsed-time timer.
Internal conditions can affect the economy, which feeds back into agents and organizations; GDP is not permanently fixed.
Business investment uses the common choice framework, including political/organizational connections as perceived consequences, norms and feasibility.
Completed business investment builds organization-held productive capacity, distinct from organizational capability.
Actual production depends on demand and operating constraints; unused capacity is possible.
Public revenue responds partly to realized economic activity and compliance; allocation remains a political/administrative choice.
Use a compact Peru pilot, source-backed anchors, declared synthetic initialization and sensitivity analysis before expanding to ten countries.
Result explanations connect consequential leadership/system events to the relevant output, outcome and impact, without claiming unsupported causality.

Business-related income uses explicit compensation and eligible distributions from organizational funds, with retention for operations and investment; respect rights, obligations and actual resources.

Use explicit domestic actors, an aggregate background domestic component for omitted activities, and a foreign component, with traceable transactions and stated adaptive/boundary rules; do not change the 1,000-agent classes.
Use fixed reference prices for the pilot; leave endogenous inflation and exchange-rate dynamics outside it. No unexplained financing or overlap between explicit and background activities.

Calculate an economic-activity index starting at 100 from realized domestic value added across explicit and background components. Starting country calibration is identical across paired runs; a GDP-per-capita equivalent requires validated scaling.

Use one simplified tax mechanism on taxable business value added, separating assessment, compliance, actual collection and unpaid liabilities. Jointly calibrate parameters to starting receipts and identify other public-receipt flows.

questions.title: Income, distribution and purchasing demand
questions.question: How should organizational production and receipts generate agents’ income, retained organizational resources and subsequent purchasing?
questions.recommendation: Use a compact explicit compensation/distribution process governed by existing roles, rights and cash constraints. Retain household needs and financial pressure; avoid a full labor market in the pilot. Ownership and eligibility for profit distributions must be defined, not inferred from Business class or membership.
questions.options: A: explicit compensation plus eligible distributions and retention; B: exogenous household incomes with only part of the feedback endogenous. Recommend A.
questions.why: Without this, production→income→demand is not closed, and earnings may be paid twice alongside old scheduled incomes.
questions.resolution: Explicit compensation, eligible distributions and retained organizational funds, governed by roles, rights, obligations and resources. Detailed payment amounts and timing remain numerical specification work.

questions.title: Financial and economic boundary
questions.question: What does the existing outside account represent, and which unmodeled domestic or external payments are permitted?
questions.recommendation: Replace its anonymous balancing role with classified boundary flows and balances. Begin with cash-constrained investment and an explicit residual sector/boundary account; do not silently add lending, government borrowing or money creation. The precise boundary still needs approval.
questions.options: A: compact open economy with declared residual-sector flows; B: fully closed represented economy requiring a more complete circular flow. Recommend A for feasibility.
questions.why: Transfers from a large outside account can sustain any arbitrary growth path unless linked to stated assumptions; eliminating them without closure can create artificial collapse.
questions.resolution: Three economic domains: explicit domestic actors, background domestic activity and foreign transactions. Background spending follows receipts/reserves and demand/capacity; foreign conditions follow stated assumptions. Every payment has a counterpart. No extra agent population or anonymous financing.

questions.title: Representation and national economic interpretation
questions.question: What share of economic activity do the synthetic business organizations represent, and how is their value added mapped to country output?
questions.recommendation: Use declared output weights and a separately identified residual economy, initially reporting an economic-activity index anchored to a consistent real-output level. Do not multiply synthetic balances or role counts into national GDP. Coverage of informal/small firms and omitted sectors must be explicit.
questions.options: A: bounded represented share plus residual economy; B: all-economy representation with more calibration. Recommend A provisionally.
questions.why: Current population composition is not survey-weighted, the formal-firm survey excludes important sectors, and the income-to-output conversion is unidentified.
questions.resolution: Use an index of realized domestic value added starting at 100. Country data establish the initial scale; the index evolves through production. Numeric component assignments and a validated GDP-per-capita conversion remain calibration work.

questions.title: Tax base and public-resource baseline
questions.question: Which taxable base and collection mechanism should the compact fiscal module use, and how are non-tax receipts and existing spending represented?
questions.recommendation: Choose one transparent assessment/collection route and calibrate its combined baseline to a matched-scope fiscal target. Keep effective receipts/GDP distinct from a statutory rate. Reconcile or remove overlapping old transfers and withholding.
questions.options: A: one simplified tax base plus declared residual receipts; B: multiple taxes, enforcement and exemption systems. Recommend A.
questions.why: Observed revenue/GDP alone cannot identify statutory rates, taxable shares and compliance; multiplying it again by compliance can depress the baseline twice.
questions.resolution: A simplified levy on taxable business value added is the core endogenous tax mechanism. Compliance and administration operate through existing decisions and constraints. Other public receipts have identified sources. Effective revenue/GDP is a calibration target, not an inserted statutory rate.

calibration_register.name: Inherited GDP per capita, current PPP
calibration_register.route: Existing resource scaling only; not a real-growth series.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Value stored in profiles.js; not independently revalidated in this draft.

calibration_register.name: Candidate GDP per capita, current USD
calibration_register.route: Price/scale context; not the real-output time-series target.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Do not combine nominal exchange-rate changes with real growth.

calibration_register.name: Real GDP per capita level
calibration_register.route: Select a consistent vintage/price base for the economic anchor.
calibration_register.uncertainty: National series located; real level not yet selected.

calibration_register.name: Real total GDP growth
calibration_register.route: Baseline plausibility target, not a guaranteed future rate.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Total GDP growth, not per-capita growth; monthly seasonality not observed.

calibration_register.name: Private investment share
calibration_register.route: Initialize investment intensity after matching private/public scope and price conventions.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Do not substitute total fixed investment or real-price ratios without disclosure.

calibration_register.name: General-government tax receipts
calibration_register.route: Target for aggregate realized receipts, not an individual tax rate.
calibration_register.uncertainty: GDP denominator/revisions and refunds must match the selected vintage.

calibration_register.name: General-government non-tax receipts
calibration_register.route: Identify residual public receipts; does not authorize free monthly injections.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Scope/mapping to treasury remains unresolved.

calibration_register.name: General-government nonfinancial spending
calibration_register.route: Baseline spending plausibility, including public work outside selected reforms.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Not all spending is production; transfers, procurement and investment differ.

calibration_register.name: Manufacturing capacity utilization
calibration_register.route: Inform initial utilized vs unused productive capacity where applicable.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Raw data/weighted estimate not extracted; manufacturing measure cannot stand for all firms.

calibration_register.name: Management regulatory burden
calibration_register.route: Target a defined regulatory-work share, not all employee time.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Formal surveyed firms only; conditional sampling and weights apply.

calibration_register.name: Operating-license delay
calibration_register.route: Compare modeled completed-license waits with a matched sample.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Mean is not an identical delay for every firm; censoring/applicant selection matter.

calibration_register.name: Bribery-request incidence
calibration_register.route: External check for the matching set of transactions and recall period.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Not per-encounter or monthly corruption probability; not a reform effect.

calibration_register.name: Visits/meetings with tax officials
calibration_register.route: Constrain tax-contact exposure after matching questionnaire period.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Prevalence does not identify repeat counts or a monthly contact rate.

calibration_register.name: Scaled role counts: Citizen, Business, Official, Politician
calibration_register.route: Preserve current Peru composition for first controlled comparison unless deliberately revised.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Not national population shares; exact total 1,000.

calibration_register.name: Public allocation shares and governance profiles
calibration_register.route: Initialize authority, approvals, protections and allocation routes for Peru.
calibration_register.uncertainty: National government indicators cannot identify organization-specific procedures.

calibration_register.name: Informal/small and omitted-sector coverage
calibration_register.route: Calibrate nonoverlapping initial output assignments for explicit and background components.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Architecture is agreed; the numerical shares and conversion are not fitted. Do not extrapolate formal sampled firms to all national activity.

calibration_register.name: Choice uncertainty scale
calibration_register.route: Preserve keyed Gumbel scale for initial extension checks.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Exploratory sensitivity proposal 0.10–0.30; not empirical confidence bounds.

calibration_register.name: Subjective-norm weight
calibration_register.route: Preserve existing choice framework.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Exploratory sensitivity 0.25–0.75, changed separately from new mechanisms.

calibration_register.name: Perceived-control weight
calibration_register.route: Preserve existing choice framework.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Exploratory sensitivity 0.125–0.375; no claim of national TPB estimates.

calibration_register.name: Reference-norm learning
calibration_register.route: Retain current reference reaction pathway unless explicitly amended.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Encounter-rate changes alter exposure dose; test interaction with repeated contacts.

calibration_register.name: Maintenance requirement
calibration_register.unit: PM per reference staff PM per month
calibration_register.route: Candidate 0.01–0.05; link to active organizational processes.
calibration_register.uncertainty: No selected default or empirical Peru estimate. Reference staff scale must be recorded.

calibration_register.name: Damage under complete maintenance shortfall
calibration_register.route: Candidate 0–0.02, with zero as a control; actual loss depends on shortfall.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Do not apply full damage as well as a second unexplained decay.

calibration_register.name: Repair productivity
calibration_register.unit: capability fraction per normalized work unit
calibration_register.route: Candidate 0.10–0.50; restoration bounded by recoverable documented loss.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Normalization is one reference full-staff month; not a calendar-month guarantee.

calibration_register.name: Rebuilding work requirement
calibration_register.route: Candidate 1–6 for a specified capability package.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Actual delay depends on allocated work and required approvals; not 1–6 calendar months.

calibration_register.name: Attention retention
calibration_register.route: Candidate 3–12; convert to decay by 1−2^(−dt/h).
calibration_register.uncertainty: Applies to issue attention, not automatic erosion of ethical commitments or mandatory duties.

calibration_register.name: Audience-specific credibility learning
calibration_register.route: Candidate 0.01–0.10 with source reliability and personal receptiveness filters.
calibration_register.uncertainty: No reputation update from hidden truth; performance credibility differs from integrity reputation.

calibration_register.name: Capital depreciation
calibration_register.route: Candidate 0.03–0.12; monthly fraction 1−(1−annual)^(1/12).
calibration_register.uncertainty: Engineering exploration only; select sector/asset evidence before a baseline value.

calibration_register.name: Capital-to-annual-output ratio
calibration_register.route: Candidate 2–5 only to expose sensitivity; productivity conversion eta=1/(12*ratio).
calibration_register.uncertainty: Not measured in this draft; do not infer stock from investment flow alone.

calibration_register.name: Compensation, retention and spending rules
calibration_register.route: Specify explicit compensation, eligible distributions, retention and settlement timing under actual cash constraints.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Do not retain old outside income in addition to replacement earnings. Q01/Q02 are resolved decision references, not pending approvals.

calibration_register.name: Tax rate, taxable share and compliance
calibration_register.unit: fractions of taxable business value added
calibration_register.route: Fit the assessment rate, eligible private-business base and baseline collection jointly; track assessment and collection separately.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Receipts/GDP do not uniquely identify components. Do not apply the revenue ratio as a statutory rate or tax public transfers as new business production.

calibration_register.name: Repeated encounter intensity
calibration_register.route: Candidate counting-process family; role, demand and capacity constrain events.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Survey prevalence cannot be inserted as a repeat-event intensity.

calibration_register.name: Routine familiarity effect
calibration_register.route: Current service expression uses 1−0.4*practice.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Extend only to explicitly named tasks; never zero out unavoidable work.

calibration_register.name: Procedural approval and waiting requirements
calibration_register.route: Use compact profiles by category and function.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Proposed numerical thresholds are not empirical law; source or label each.

calibration_register.name: Policy-value/performance belief learning
calibration_register.route: Reuse bounded subjective learning architecture with separate targets.
calibration_register.uncertainty: No generic policy-success target or automatic reward for funding.

calibration_register.name: Coalition costs and commitment amounts
calibration_register.route: Reserve actual own resources and track delivery of commitments.
calibration_register.uncertainty: Does not authorize stakeholder top-ups to the policy implementation pool.

calibration_register.name: Event-log and experiment limits
calibration_register.route: 1,000 agents; test paired 120-month runs and repeated runs sequentially.
calibration_register.uncertainty: No measured Android time/memory result exists for the proposed extension.
